title: Account Executive, Immunology – Portland, OR
description:

Immunology Account Executives serve as a resource for hospitals, group practices and specialty pharmacies that are focused on treating immunological diseases including rheumatoid arthritis, psoriatic disease, atopic dermatitis, and Crohn’s disease.
Responsibilities include learning and development of key account management skills including immunology franchise collaboration and communication, non- branded value based acumen, effective business planning, targeted account execution to deliver measurable impact. Immunology Account Managers provide materials and share data that show both the clinical and economic value treatment as well as positive impact the treatment can have on patient outcomes and organizational goals.
This role is field-based, and candidates should live within a reasonable distance from the primary city. Talent will be hired at a level commensurate with experience.
This geography covers the states of Oregon and Alaska.
Key Responsibilities:
Serve as account manager for assigned geographic location. Locations preferable but not limited to higher base of influential group practices and or limited IDN presence as well as smaller amount of franchise internal business partners.
Lead and drive visible and inclusive portfolio KAM collaboration through consistent communication, follow up and feedback leading to impactful solutions.
Develop of targeted, comprehensive, compliant business and account plans with diversity of input from field partners executing account based resources with high efficiency.
Deliver consistent mastery and execution of immunology portfolio products in key IAE initiatives to drive increased sales and market share.
Provide details on effective disease management and empowering process change using clinical and economic data that impact the treatment of patients across providers in an organization.
Share a variety of tools to help elevate patient support and standardize care, such as clinical pathways, order sets, flow sheets.
Clearly and consistently lead and manage communication (written and verbal) on strategic and tactical insights on target accounts to Immunology District Managers and other internal business partners creating two-way accountability.
Demonstrate perseverance and resiliency to tailor and execute deliverables along call continuum leading to an account’s taking specific action for implementation and impact.
Routinely identify local opportunities and threats and develop/modify business plans accordingly.  Partner with IAE and Immunology stakeholders to effectively lead without authority in a complex matrix environment.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree required.
Proven ability to succeed with at least 5 years Immunology franchise or sales or account management experience.
Demonstrated business results by delivering sales numbers for targeted accounts and performance to Field Force Effectiveness measures.
Consistent positive influence and culture of cross-functional collaboration and communication partnerships across functional areas through demonstrated positive stakeholder feedback.
Effective development of business planning, organizational and project management skills, consistently demonstrated with diversity of input from field partners and sales manager.
Proven record of delivering beyond prescriptive selling balancing, organizing and focusing on quality of care and enhanced patient experience on behalf of the patients we serve.
Driving a personal auto or company car or truck, or a powered piece of material handling equipment
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements.

description:

AbbVie’s Global Forecasting Center of Excellence sets forecasting standards and builds the analytical capabilities that guide enterprise planning. As Associate Director, AI Forecasting, you will lead the operation, expansion, and governance of AI and machine learning models used to forecast commercial volume across brands and geographies. You will set technical standards, guide model development and deployment, and partner with forecasting, finance, technology, and business leaders to keep model outputs reliable, explainable, scalable, and aligned with planning cycles.

Lead the operation and maintenance of AI/ML forecasting models, ensuring their ongoing accuracy, reliability, performance, and fitness for use in commercial forecasting.
Ensure model outputs are delivered on schedule to support financial planning cycles and downstream business deadlines.
Define and maintain standards for developing new forecasting models, including data requirements, feature engineering, model selection, validation, documentation, integration, and handoff.
Partner with forecasters, brand teams, finance leaders, and technology teams to understand business dynamics, curate inputs, determine when model changes are warranted, and integrate approved changes into operational workflows.
Translate complex or counterintuitive model results into clear, well-supported business explanations that help leaders understand and confidently use model outputs.

Lead, coach, and develop a team of forecasting data science professionals, setting priorities, allocating work, providing feedback, and building technical capability as the modeling portfolio grows.

Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or Mathematics (advanced degree strongly preferred).
7+ years of progressive experience in quantitative or analytical roles, with demonstrated depth in machine learning model development, validation, deployment, and ongoing operation.
Expert-level proficiency in machine learning, including time-series forecasting, supervised learning, ensemble methods, and model performance evaluation.
Proficiency in Python and/or R, with hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-grade ML models.
Ability to translate business context into modeling decisions and communicate technical outputs clearly to non-technical audiences and senior leaders.
Experience leading technical teams or workstreams and delivering high-quality results across multiple concurrent priorities in a complex, matrixed environment.
Strong documentation, knowledge management, problem-solving, and judgment.

Experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences commercial analytics, forecasting, or data science.
Experience with commercial volume forecasting and pharmaceutical data sources, such as prescription, patient flow, distribution, and epidemiology data.
Experience integrating AI/ML models into operational business processes with defined planning cycles and downstream dependencies.
Familiarity with enterprise forecasting platforms and model governance frameworks.
Experience evaluating large language models, generative AI, or other emerging analytical methods in a business context.

title: Corporate Catering & Events Manager
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Position Summary
The Corporate Catering & Events Manager provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for corporate catering and event services across multiple Lake County campus locations at AbbVie. Reporting to the Manager, Foodservice Operations, this position is responsible for developing, standardizing, and growing an enterprise catering program that delivers exceptional hospitality experiences while supporting organizational objectives.
This role will lead the design and implementation of catering systems, service standards, menu programs, operating procedures, technology solutions, and training initiatives that create consistency across all locations. Initially, the position will focus on building these foundational capabilities while providing oversight of current catering and event operations . As the program matures, the Corporate Catering & Events Manager will oversee daily catering and event operations, financial performance, stakeholder relationships, and team development while ensuring an elevated customer experience for all clients, guests, and executive stakeholders.
The successful candidate is a hospitality leader with a passion for service excellence, operational efficiency, client experience, and business growth.
Key Responsibilities
1. Enterprise Catering Program Leadership
Lead the strategic development and execution of the corporate catering program, establishing scalable service models, operating standards, menu packages, hospitality guidelines, and business processes that support long-term growth and operational consistency.
2. Team Leadership & Development
Provide direct leadership to two Catering Operations Group Leaders and indirect leadership to the broader catering and events teams. Foster a culture of accountability, hospitality, collaboration, professional development, and service excellence.
3. Operational Excellence
Oversee daily catering and event operations across multiple locations, ensuring seamless coordination, execution, and service delivery while maintaining consistent standards across all catering programs.
4. Menu & Service Innovation
Partner with culinary leadership to develop and continuously enhance catering menus, package offerings, service tiers, and event solutions that meet client needs, reflect industry trends, and drive program growth. Ensure catering and event services appropriately address dietary, allergen, cultural, religious, accessibility, and other accommodation requirements while maintaining consistent standards for food safety and guest experience.
5. Systems, Technology & Process Improvement
Lead the implementation and ongoing management of catering technology platforms, online ordering systems, reporting tools, and operational processes. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures that improve efficiency, accuracy, and the customer experience.
6. Event Planning & Execution
Oversee the planning and execution of corporate meetings, executive events, VIP functions, conferences, and large-scale organizational events, ensuring flawless coordination from initial request through final delivery. Develop contingency plans for service disruptions, staffing challenges, facility issues, supplier delays, and other event-related risks.
7. Financial & Revenue Management
Manage catering revenue performance, food cost controls, labor utilization, and operational expenses. Identify opportunities to grow revenue, improve cost recovery, increase operational efficiency, and achieve financial objectives.
8. Client & Stakeholder Engagement
Build and maintain strong relationships with administrative partners, corporate clients, executive stakeholders, and event sponsors. Serve as the primary escalation point for service concerns and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
9. Compliance, Safety & Quality Assurance
Ensure compliance with all food safety, sanitation, workplace safety, and company policies. Maintain operational standards that align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices while promoting a safe working environment.
10. Strategic Growth & Continuous Improvement

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. AbbVie’s Business Technology Solutions (BTS) Information Research (IR) organization is seeking an Engineer, Technology I to help deliver trusted, well-structured, AI-ready data products within ARCH, AbbVie’s R&D Convergence Hub. As part of the DELOS team — Data Exploration and Linked Outcome Solutions — this role helps build the reliable data foundations needed to advance analytics, reporting, knowledge graph capabilities, machine learning, and AI-enabled use cases across R&D.
In this role, you will independently design and develop data pipelines and curated data assets within assigned projects, applying established architecture, engineering patterns, and governance standards. You will collect, integrate, normalize, model, and document research data; implement quality checks; and support publication to the ARCH knowledge graph. Rather than developing AI models directly, you will prepare reliable, accessible, and appropriately governed data for analytics, data science, and AI-enabled use cases.
Working with R&D stakeholders, data scientists, machine learning engineers, platform teams, architects, and data owners, you will translate defined scientific and business requirements into dependable data solutions. You will perform routine and complex engineering tasks independently, understand project objectives and your contribution to them, adapt your approach when needed, and communicate progress, risks, and issues. You will collaborate with internal and contracted engineers on assigned work, seeking guidance on broader architecture decisions and escalating issues outside your scope.
Under the direction of the Associate Director – Data Strategy, AI & Knowledge Enablement, this role contributes to AbbVie’s R&D data transformation by delivering consistent, well-documented data solutions within agreed project scope and timelines. You will learn and apply new methods and technologies to help research partners use trusted data for scientific decision-making.
**This is a hybrid role based in Lake County, IL (Tue, Wed, Thu)
Responsibilities
Data Pipeline & Product Development: Independently design and develop pipelines and curated data assets for assigned scientific or business use cases. Collect, integrate, normalize, model, and transform data from databases, applications, APIs, licensed external sources, and other systems using established engineering patterns.
Reliable Project Delivery: Perform routine and complex engineering tasks competently and independently, producing reliable and consistent results within agreed timelines. Understand broader project objectives, organize assigned work, and adapt your approach when requirements or priorities change.
AI & Knowledge Graph Data Preparation: Clean, standardize, enrich, and structure data and documents for downstream analytics, machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and knowledge discovery. Organize metadata, support established chunking and embedding workflows, and prepare curated assets for publication to the ARCH knowledge graph.
Data Quality & Technical Documentation: Implement defined data quality checks and maintain technical documentation for pipelines and data assets, including metadata, lineage, transformations, assumptions, and usage guidance. Apply established access, privacy, licensing, and governance requirements.

Organization and culture: Build and lead a high-performing digital strategy, architecture, and portfolio team; develop talent, digital fluency, and a continuous improvement and innovation culture across Operations.

Proven track record of setting multi-year digital roadmaps and delivering scaled, measurable value across multiple sites and functions (manufacturing, supply chain, quality/QC, engineering, PDS&T).
Deep understanding of Industry 4.0/5.0 and digital manufacturing technologies (MES/MOM, IIoT, data platforms, digital twins, advanced process control, robotics/automation, AI/ML and GenAI) and their application in GxP environments.
Working knowledge of GxP/GMP, data integrity (ALCOA+), computer system assurance, and OT/IT cybersecurity expectations for pharma operations.
Experience establishing digital governance, architecture standards, and investment/benefit-management frameworks in partnership with IT/BTS and Finance.
Demonstrated executive presence and ability to influence senior leaders, build coalitions, and navigate a complex global matrix organization.
Strong change leadership skills, with experience driving adoption of new technologies and ways of working at scale.
Experience building and developing leaders and multidisciplinary teams; consulting or external technology-partner experience is a plus.
Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technology concepts into business outcomes.

General Position Summary/Purpose:
The Market Access and Patient Services Insights (MAPS) organization within APEX plays an instrumental role in shaping market access strategies for all of AbbVie’s US brands. As a member of this team, you will lead the planning and execution of primary/ secondary market research to identify payer opportunities and threats, influence the development of market access strategies and tactics, enable organizational learning, and ensure alignment of insights with the broader commercial goals of each brand.  This is a hybrid role with the focus on Primary Market Research with an opportunity for some data analytics.
The role requires strong research experience as well as subject matter expertise within the overall U.S. market access environment. The role provides insights that directly impact patient and physician access to AbbVie brands through its influence on the development of pricing, contracting, messaging and other access strategies.
Key Accountabilities/Core Job Responsibilities:
Lead primary and secondary market research activities on a key oncology brand and/or launch indications that influence market access through fact-based analysis, customer insights and business knowledge. Co-develop with U.S. Market Access commercial leaders, innovative Pricing and Contracting strategies to achieve optimal payer formulary access that maximize net sales for assigned brands. Deliver customer insights through market research, competitive simulation, and customer/environmental modeling to understand complex economic and clinical dynamics that drive payer access and shape brand demand. Demonstrate strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare landscape and key AbbVie therapeutic areas to identify and proactively address opportunities and threats. Build collaborative relationships with internal U.S. Market Access Sales and Marketing stakeholders. Align insights to Brand insight partners, that when integrated with HCP and Consumer insights, positively impacts brand decision making.
Key areas of functional scope include:
Leading the creative process for developing GPO, IDN, Specialty Pharmacy, Health Plan and PBM go-to-market strategies for launch brands across payer channels and conveying analytical narratives that describe the market environment influencing stakeholder negotiations.
Leading the delivery of brand specific market access insights and response to specific market access issues/ trends. Areas of depth include gross/net pricing, contracting strategy, value proposition development, implications of competitive launches on access, investigative analytics related to market events and competitive actions, strategies for payer formulary coverage and reimbursement, and identifying value drivers that guide clinical data development and value positioning.

Responsible for leading the communication of market access insights to leadership requiring a broad range of market access expertise as these brands commonly experience differing market access challenges.

Master’s degree or MBA
Oncology Experience
Strong working knowledge of syndicated pharmaceutical data sources.
3 years of pharmaceutical market access experience and subject matter expertise with Health Plans, PBMs, Hospital Systems, Specialty Pharmacies and Healthcare Policy stakeholders

title: Sr. Inside Sales Business Development Manager
description:
About Allergan Aesthetics
At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our aesthetics portfolio includes facial injectables, body contouring, plastics, skin care, and more. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit https://global.allerganaesthetics.com/. Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.
This is a hybrid role including in office and remote working days. Must be a resident or relocatable to Austin TX area.
Must be able to work one of the below shifts:
8:00am-4:30pm CT, or 8:30-5:00pmCT, 7:30-4:30pmCT or 8:00-5pmCT
The Sr Inside Sales Business Development Manager is a revenue generating position with responsibility for quarterly sales quota attainment for the Facial Aesthetics portfolio of products (BOTOX® Cosmetic, JUVÉDERM® Collection of Fillers, SkinMedica®, KYBELLA®) and for managing and enhancing portfolio growth through business development activities using primarily phone communication.
The Sr IBDM represents the Allergan Aesthetics product portfolio to targeted aesthetic customers within a designated geographical area. Responsible for product and program education, product adoption, and portfolio growth through business development activities.
The Sr IBDM provides technical product and procedure training, as well as competitive product differentiation.  Assigned sales goals are obtained through strategic analysis of account data, strong knowledge of accounts aesthetic goals, understanding of market dynamics, application of consultative selling and implementation of the U.S. Sales/Marketing plan.  The company offers flexible career paths with a strong emphasis on opportunity for internal mobility.
Allergan Sr IBDMs must:
Leverage Allergan Medical resources to enhance adoption of the Allergan Medical Aesthetics Portfolio.  Synergistically work and coordinate activities with other Allergan sales personnel and support teams (include, but are not limited to, Facial Aesthetics, CoolSculpting®, SkinMedica®, and Marketing).  Complies with required reports, requests, and compliance policies.
Key Duties and Responsibilities:
Consistently achieves sales quota across portfolio. Proficient in sales execution component of marketing plans. Independently creates call and business development plans across the product portfolio. Demonstrates adaptability and creativity with multiple initiatives.
Sales processes must be focused toward business growth and relationship building.
Manages attainment of assigned sales quota and customer satisfaction through consistent communication with the Regional Manager and Inside Sales Area Manager, managing own sample allocation, placing orders, providing marketing materials, and assisting accounts with marketing strategies.   Also leads execution on all campaigns/promotions, new product launches, training of accounts on Allergan programs and other sales related initiatives.

title: Creative Lead, Art
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
Airbnb is a creative company on a mission to connect people to the magic of the real world. You’ll join a collaborative, excellence-driven creative group led by the VP of Global Creative, and report directly to the Director of Brand Creative. Working in close, day-to-day partnership with your copy partner, strategists, and producers, you’ll be part of an agile team dedicated to bold storytelling across our key verticals. Here, innovative thinking and hands-on craft are deeply valued, and your work will directly shape the future of our brand.
The Difference You Will Make
As a Creative Lead (Art), you will be the visual driving force behind high-impact integrated campaigns and social work across our highest-growth verticals, including Home/Stay, Experiences, Services, and more.
Working in a close dynamic partnership with a dedicated Copywriter partner, you will directly bridge high-level brand narrative and provocative modern visual execution. Together, you won't just generate big ideas; you will bring them to life across social channels and traditional media touchpoints with exceptional craft, vision, and speed.
A Typical Day:
Partner on Big Ideas: Work side-by-side with your Copywriter partner to conceptualize and execute integrated, multi-channel campaigns.
Elevate Visual Craft: Turn brand stories into visually stunning, culturally resonant campaigns, delivering excellent, beautiful work at pace.
Shape Integrated Storytelling: Seamlessly connect social-first visual thinking with multi-channel campaigns, ensuring aesthetic consistency and craft across every touchpoint.
Collaborate with Leadership: Work directly with Creative Leadership and cross-functional teams to execute high-visibility work that moves the business forward.
Embrace a Maker Spirit: Bring a hands-on, proactive builder mindset—scrappy, curious, and excited to dive into the work and prototype ideas quickly.
Leverage AI & Modern Creative Tools: Fluent with AI creative tools and emerging digital workflows to accelerate ideation, iteration, and visual storytelling without compromising quality.
Direct Production Craft: Ensure exceptional visual and art direction execution while communicating effectively with creative teammates, and production companies.
Your Expertise:
10+ years of relevant experience leading global brand campaigns, preferably a mix of advertising agency, creative studio, and in-house experience.
Outstanding portfolio demonstrating best-in-class campaign work.
Demonstrated success in leading multiple cross-media campaigns.
Strong conceptual and brainstorming skills, leading and participating whenever needed.
Experience collaborating closely with Brand Management teams. Ability to translate market research, data, and strategy to creative solutions.
Flexible and dependable.
Ability to think both strategically and tactically, concept through execution.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills—you can effectively communicate and passionately defend decisions.
Empathy for the customer, and empathy for individuals on a creative team.
Passionate about Airbnb’s mission and purpose.

title: AWS Sr. Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure, US West
description:
Amazon Web Services has an immediate opening for a Senior Technical Program Manager to support data center infrastructure expansion. The TPM will lead cross functional teams to drive regional data center build projects, from inception through design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.
Candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must.
The TPM will be fully competent in a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated proficiency in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Other requirements include proficiency with MS Office, MS Project and MS SharePoint. Experience with Tableau, Smartsheets, SQL and systems integration a plus.
This position requires 25% Travel (Domestic and International trips to AWS Data Center Clusters).
If you meet these qualifications, exude passion, and enjoy the challenges of deploying highly technical and innovative projects at massive scale, this job is for you!
About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Every day, hundreds of Amazon teams across Retail, Prime, Prime Video, Music, Alexa, and more reach customers through email, push, SMS, and messaging apps. You'll own click-through rate, conversion, and incremental sales per message across channels, and the technical products that move them: personalization and recommendations in messages, send-time and channel optimization, new creative and interactive experiences, conversational and messaging channels, and the experimentation engine that tells us what works.

You'll ship the winners as platform capabilities that every sending team can use, not one-off campaign tweaks. title: AI Software Engineer, App Intelligence
description:
Join the App Intelligence team and help redefine what a deeply personal and integrated assistant can be. As part of the Siri organization, you will help shape one of the world's most widely used AI assistants, powered by our next generation of Apple Intelligence — with capabilities like personal context understanding and on-screen awareness, built with privacy from the ground up. We are engineers, scientists, and problem solvers working to bring smarter, faster, and more natural interactions to millions of users worldwide. As a Software Engineer on our team, you will build the on-device runtime foundation that powers Siri, enabling seamless, intelligent, and secure experiences with direct, meaningful impact across iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS.
App Intelligence is the on-device system that turns app capabilities into things a user can simply ask for — and makes the assistant reliable enough to be trusted with them. We partner closely with the team that builds Siri's planning and execution engine, and we own the app side of that partnership: what apps can offer, how they express it, and whether the resulting experience is good enough to trust. As a platform engineer, you will build the on-device software this depends on and make the resulting experiences reliable and fast. This is early work. How apps should best expose themselves to an assistant is still an open question — you will help answer it by designing the interfaces, proving them out with real app partners, and iterating as we learn. Expect real ambiguity, and expect to form your own view of the right architecture and defend it with working software and measured results.
Minimum qualifications: BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience, with 5+ years developing and shipping production software.
Strong proficiency in C++, Swift, or Objective-C, with a solid understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
Strong understanding of OS internals, concurrency, multithreading, and memory management.
Strong familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI assistants, with fluency in agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, and good judgment about where to apply them and how to verify what they produce.
Experience with system performance analysis and optimization techniques.
Ability to work independently, solve complex problems, and learn new technologies quickly.
Excellent communication skills, with experience collaborating across different technical teams and driving alignment on shared API surfaces.
Preferred qualifications: Proficiency with Swift and Xcode, with experience building applications for Apple platforms.
Experience designing and developing systems that are efficient in resource-constrained environments — latency, memory, and power budgets on device.
Experience working on AI software runtimes or agent orchestration frameworks, or on voice assistants / conversational AI systems leveraging LLMs.
Experience building software features driven by LLMs, including designing tool and function-calling interfaces, constructing context, and validating model output.
Experience with API design or framework development, including key software components and APIs used cross-functionally across different applications and platforms, and versioning and compatibility of interfaces that shipped clients depend on.
Experience with evaluation or telemetry infrastructure that measures the end-to-end quality of LLM-driven features (e.g., Python, SQL, dashboards).
Experience leading the design of complex features or driving architectural decisions across teams (for candidates at the more senior end of the range).

title: Applied Research Software Engineer
description:
You are a technical leader with a demonstrated track record of identifying the right problems, taking calculated risks, and shipping at scale. The candidate will be a core contributor on an interdisciplinary team of specialized researchers and engineers focused on emerging technologies. As an Applied Research Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for leading end-to-end incubations from early ideation to deployment, applying state-of-the-art ML research, algorithmic innovation, and agentic systems to challenges with both immediate and long-term impact. You bring deep intellectual curiosity, the ability to operate at the frontier of new technologies, and excellent communication skills to align company leaders and cross-functional collaborators alike.
The work is hands-on, highly cross-disciplinary, and central to shaping how Apple’s intelligent systems evolve. You’ll be working on the pipeline between research and product that unlocks the kinds of the delightful user experiences Apple is known for, iteratively crafting ideas that turn science fiction into reality. You care deeply about the process of applied scientific research, enjoy supporting technology investigations, and are comfortable jumping across multiple layers of the productization process when the team calls on you, from prototype through shipping. This is not a typical ML engineering role where you will be responsible for an existing system in a large team: instead, the work is equal parts interdisciplinary pathfinding and helping realize your projects as critical features of Apple’s next-gen products.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science or adjacent technical field
6+ years of engineering experience building and maintaining data-intensive systems - including feature pipelines, training infrastructure, or evaluation frameworks.
Strong proficiency in both Python and C++ with experience in complex, multi-language systems.
Expertise in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch.
Familiarity with SOTA ML approaches (VLMs, diffusion models, RL, etc.)
Preferred qualifications: Close to the frontier. You’re the person your friends come to when a new model drops or a new research paper emerges as state-of-the-art.
Experience with a specialty discipline such as robotics & machine perception, computer vision, graphics, or simulation.
An interest in contextual, personalized computing and the supporting principles of cognitive science and psychology.
A strong point of view on where human-AI interaction is headed — and a drive to be a leading part of creating ethical, privacy-centric products.
Experience with real-time or near-real-time systems and deeply integrated architectures that span local SoCs through cloud compute.
Familiarity with hardware bring-up, data communication protocols, or sensor integration.

title: BSR Noise & Vibration Engineer
description:
At Apple, extraordinary ideas have a way of quickly becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Sound is an essential and compelling facet of the customer experience. Apple has assembled an elite Acoustics team that enables our customers to experience music with delight, communicate with clarity, and enjoy elegant sound throughout our product line. In Apple Acoustics we work with the utmost attention to detail, directly impacting the design of products that millions of people around the world love!
Our Noise & Vibration team contributes to hardware design, validation, and troubleshooting to minimize distracting audible noises and optimize their sound quality. We are a diverse team of acoustics and vibration experts, accomplished listeners, and creative problem solvers. We work daily with multifunctional teams on innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges. We are looking for a Noise & Vibration Engineer to join our team. Could this be you?
As a BSR Noise & Vibration engineer, you will quantify noises, facilitate user studies, and establish thresholds in lab and factory environments. You will collaborate with cross functional teams to troubleshoot, identify source, and fix noises found during testing by providing design feedback to design teams. The analysis of the validation work that you will lead will help you to better understand root causes of various problems. To accomplish these tasks you will author procedures, test plans and specifications. As a part of a team, you will develop and facilitate use of objective test stations. You will work closely with team members who support product development builds at factories but will need to travel minimally.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering / Acoustics or equivalent field.
5+ years minimum experience in product development that includes acoustic design validation as well as vibration mitigation design.
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally.
Preferred qualifications: Knowledge of acoustic and vibration principles and how motion of mechanical systems turns into radiated noise.
Acoustic and vibration measurement skills with experience making measurements in anechoic/hemi-anechoic chambers and with data analysis /signal processing methodologies.
Ability to quantify noise response relationship to a system’s excitation (motion, thermal, or other) to effectively guide design improvements.
Accomplished listener with excellent hearing over the audible frequency range.
Ability to effectively communicate complex information and concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Creative problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced multi-tasking environment.
Familiarity with statistical analysis methods, experience with precision-grade instrumentation including ultra low noise measurements, knowledge in electro-magnetic actuators, and familiarity with Matlab or other flexible data analysis software.

title: Creator Studio Asset Manager
description:

Strong grasp of metadata standards, taxonomy design, and search/retrieval optimization. Experience partnering with engineering teams to scope and build custom tools or integrations. Familiarity with photo/video production workflows, licensing and usage rights, and archiving best practices.

Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, able to work fluidly across creative, legal, and engineering teams.

Background in photography, visual arts, or creative production.

Exposure to emerging areas such as generative imagery, 3D asset generation, or spatial/volumetric content.
Experience establishing an asset management practice from the ground up in an ambiguous or fast-evolving environment.

description:

title: Materials Scientist - Capacitors
description:
Join Apple's innovative hardware team as a Materials Scientist for Capacitors, where you will own Apple's technology strategy across the polymer, electrolytic, film, and safety capacitor families — driving critical component solutions from initial concept to high-volume mass production across all Apple product lines.
In this senior role, you will serve as the primary technical expert bridging Apple's cross-functional teams with our global network of capacitor suppliers across the full non-MLCC capacitor space: tantalum polymer (including PFAS-free transition), aluminum polymer, aluminum electrolytic, film, safety/Y-rated, and emerging electrochemical energy storage technologies. You will be responsible for predicting component performance from supplier process choices — pellet morphology and sintering chemistry, oxide film formation kinetics, foil etch architecture, winding geometry, and conductive polymer chemistry — rather than relying on datasheet specifications, and will set Apple's technology direction across these families 3+ years ahead of integration. You will work closely with our existing Passive Component Technologists, SI/PI teams, LOB EEs, and commodity managers across iPhone, iPad, Watch, Mac, AirPods, Vision, Power Adapters, and beyond. This is an exceptional opportunity for a scientist or engineer with deep materials science or electrochemistry expertise who is passionate about making a significant impact at Apple. This role requires approximately 10–20% overseas travel.
Minimum qualifications: Deep Polymer, Film, and Safety Capacitor Expertise — Extensive professional experience across tantalum polymer (MnO₂ and conductive-polymer types, including PFAS-free pellet and termination chemistry), aluminum polymer & electrolytic (etch architecture, conductive layer deposition, ESR/ESL behavior), film capacitor construction (winding geometry, self-healing metallization, voltage derating), and safety/Y-rated capacitors (safe-failure construction, IEC 60384-14 X/Y classification, creepage and clearance). Proficiency in material characterization, DC-bias degradation, surge and leakage current reliability, and construction-to-performance modeling is required.
Materials Science and Electrochemistry Depth — Command of the physical mechanisms driving capacitor behavior: dielectric oxide formation kinetics (Ta₂O₅, Al₂O₃), pellet porosity and sintering, polymer conductivity and thermal stability, self-healing metallization failure modes, leakage current mechanisms, and capacitor-level safe-failure design. Ability to challenge and evaluate supplier process and material claims from first principles.
Cross-Disciplinary Knowledge — Familiarity with PDN and EMI filter circuit topologies, power supply design, IEC safety standards and regulatory frameworks (including PFAS/REACH restrictions and their supply-chain implications), and device-level reliability requirements across consumer electronics product categories.
Program Management and Influence — Proven ability to work as an individual contributor within a highly cross-functional environment. Must possess strong interpersonal skills to identify technical challenges, engage with suppliers, drive solutions, and manage development programs to successful and on-schedule delivery.
Hands-On Manufacturing Experience — A minimum of 5 years (preferably in a recent role) of direct, on-site factory floor experience with capacitor manufacturing processes is mandatory.
Education and Experience — PhD in Materials Science & Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, or Physics with a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience in capacitor or passive component technologies.
Preferred qualifications: Solid track record of leading passive component product development from concept to mass-production across multiple capacitor technology families
Experience with PFAS-free materials qualification and supplier transition management
Familiarity with MLCC ceramic dielectric R&D and supercapacitor / EDLC construction and reliability limits is a plus
In-depth knowledge of capacitor supply chains, including tantalum ore sourcing, aluminum foil markets, and polymer electrolyte supply base
Strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated cross-LOB technical collaboration

title: Sr. Optical Safety Engineer
description:

We are seeking a technically rigorous and collaborative optical safety engineer to serve as the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for laser and LED product safety. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge photonics engineering and global regulatory compliance — you will own the safety strategy for optical systems across Apple's consumer and professional product lines, from early-stage design review through certification and mass production. If you have deep expertise in IEC 60825-1 and IEC 60825-2, a passion for building safety into products rather than checking boxes at the end, and the communication skills to lead cross-functional alignment at every level of the organization, this role was built for you.

You will lead compliance efforts to IEC 60825-1/IEC 60825-2 and IEC 62471, conduct and oversee optical hazard analysis, drive certification, and own the technical relationship with external test laboratories and certification bodies. You will apply rigorous engineering methods, including FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and Design of Experiments, to characterize risk, drive root-cause resolution, and prevent recurrence across product families.
Beyond the technical work, this role requires someone who can communicate complex optical safety requirements clearly to non-specialists, write reports suitable for submission to global regulatory authorities, and present findings and recommendations confidently to both engineering and executive audiences. You will also work closely with suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure optical safety requirements are correctly implemented and sustained through production.
Experience with ICT product certification frameworks, particularly where optical subsystems interface with server or communications infrastructure (IEC 62368-1, IECEE CB Scheme, CISPR), is a meaningful advantage in this role, as Apple's optical safety scope continues to expand into other product categories.
This is a high-visibility, high-ownership position for an engineer who brings both technical depth and the maturity to serve as a trusted partner across one of Apple's most cross-functional organizations.

2+ years of hands-on experience characterizing optical and optoelectronic devices, including laser sources, LEDs, photodetectors, and fiber-optic components
Experience performing optical hazard analysis, accessible emission limit (AEL) calculations, and optical power/irradiance measurements
Experience conducting FMEA and Fault Tree Analysis in the context of product safety
Experience managing technical relationships with external test labs, vendors, and certification bodies to develop and qualify product designs
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate complex optical safety requirements into clear guidance for non-specialists, and to write technical reports suitable for submission to regulatory bodies
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; comfortable working across hardware engineering, legal, regulatory affairs, and operations teams with competing priorities
Confident working independently while also being a reliable, engaged team contributor

Comfortable presenting technical findings and recommendations to engineering and executive audiences
Preferred qualifications: PhD in Physics, Optical Physics, Electro-Optics, or Electrical Engineering - new grad to 1 year of industry experience or PhD with 2 to 4 years of industry experience in optical safety, laser systems, or related photonics applications

Familiarity with ICT product certification frameworks (IEC 62368-1, CB Scheme, FCC Part 15/18, CISPR 32/35) as they intersect with optical safety, particularly for data center or server products

Experience with manufacturing process audits and supplier quality in the context of photonic or electro-optic assemblies

title: Video Processing Engineer
description:
Do you love problem solving in a collaborative environment and then having the results of your efforts benefitting millions around the world? At Apple, our Architecture group is responsible for connecting our hardware and software into one unified system. Join this team, and you’ll collaborate with engineers across Apple to design how all of our technologies work in unison! You’ll drive development of our renowned system-on-a-chip architecture and develop algorithms to improve image quality and enable new use cases. You’ll develop forward-looking prototype systems as well as build and deploy software development tools that will be distributed to the Apple engineering community and help build the seamless technology experiences we’re known for worldwide.
This role will be responsible for investigating techniques for improving video processing solutions along the quality vs. power axes. State-of-the-art video processing solutions often involve the use of Machine Learning, but this can be computationally intensive and not practical. There exists a computational gap between Machine Learning techniques and traditional methods. The goal is to find operating points in between that can leverage the improved quality due to Machine Learning when needed and fall back to traditional, low-compute methods when not needed. Examples of video processing solutions that can benefit from using a hybrid solution comprised of traditional techniques and Machine Learning based techniques include (but not limited to) 1) Under Display Camera enhancement 2) Motion Estimation for Codec, GGM and MCTF 3) Face ID processing. The result of finding hybrid solutions is better video quality and/or longer battery life on the Phone, Pad and Mac. You will be responsible for investigating hybrid video processing techniques that can be translated into efficient SoC architectures. You will be expected to be able to translate architectures into specifications and C-models. You will also be expected to work cross-functionally with other Architects as well as Design and DV.
• Investigate and develop hybrid video processing architectures.
• Support chip architecture team and software teams to map algorithms into well-defined architectures that can be implemented in software and/or hardware.
• Generate architecture test vectors for quality validation.
• Write bit exact C-models of defined architectures.
• Support Design and Verification teams when verifying designs against bit exact C-models.
Minimum qualifications: BS degree
Ability to program in the following languages: Python, PyTorch and/or C/C++
Understanding of image/video/signal processing fundamentals
Understanding of neural network fundamentals
Preferred qualifications: MS or PhD degree or 3+ years of experience
Demonstrated ability of developing new image/video processing algorithms
Experience in developing neural network based image/video processing algorithms
Communication skills and ability to work across various groups
Understanding of fixed point representation and processing and/or ability to write bit-accurate software models
Understanding of pipelining and pixel processing architectures
Knowledge of computer architecture fundamentals

title: WiFi MAC Design Verification Engineer
description:
The Apple ecosystem harnesses multiple wireless technologies to deliver an unparalleled user experience. The Wireless Connectivity Silicon (WCS) team spearheads the development of complex System-on-Chip (SoCs) like the N1 family, enabling this experience in both current and future Apple products. By leveraging cutting-edge processes, tools, workflows, unique proprietary features, and advanced architecture, the team strives to provide the best wireless connectivity solutions. The WCS organization anticipates substantial growth to meet the diverse silicon tape-outs for various product lines at Apple in the coming years. This presents significant growth opportunities for building new infrastructure. If you’re passionate about wireless technologies, eager to work on next-generation infrastructure, and committed to continuous learning, this is the ideal place for you.
As a Wireless MAC Design Verification Engineer, you’ll be instrumental in our WCS group’s verification initiatives, ensuring that our products incorporate cutting-edge Wi-Fi technology while maintaining high quality and reliability. We’re looking for candidates with hands-on experience in the entire ASIC design verification cycle, preferably with expertise in reusable verification methodologies like UVM or similar. This position offers excellent opportunities to deepen your knowledge of Wi-Fi protocols, complex IP and subsystems, and fabric protocols. You’ll also be collaborating closely with system architects, design, software, and firmware teams. The ideal candidate will excel in detailed test planning, adapt to evolving requirements, build test bench infrastructure, perform regressions, close coverage, and leverage various AI tools to streamline DV processes and expedite debugging. Prior knowledge of wireless domain or MAC verification is a plus. If you’re passionate about contributing to products that have a global impact and want to advance your technical expertise, we’d love to hear from you.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelors in EE or related field.
Knowledge of standard ASIC design and verification flows, simulation and testbench development.
Skills with constrained random testing, coverage closure, gate level simulations.
Preferred qualifications: Knowledge of Wireless Connectivity or MAC verification.
Advanced knowledge of System Verilog and the UVM methodology.
Experience using AI-based tools for verification (e.g., Claude Code or similar) to improve efficiency and automation.
Team player with excellent communication skills and the desire to take on diverse challenges.

title: Industrial IT Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on, customer-focused IT Support Specialist to join our factory IT team at Base. You’ll help keep our flagship battery factory (BF1) and warehouse network running around the clock.

You’ll be the first point of contact for factory and warehouse IT issues, managing tickets and walk-ups while troubleshooting technology directly on the production floor. This hands-on role includes racking switches, calibrating label printers, provisioning scanners, and resolving issues that could bring production stations to a halt.

This is a designated second-shift role. You must be available to work Monday through Friday, 3 p.m. to 12 a.m. Your assigned shift will depend on team coverage needs and may change as the company and team grow.

This role will require periodic travel to our facilities across Texas and, as we expand, other states. You’ll primarily support factory and warehouse operations but will also provide IT support to the broader company as needed.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Provide hands-on technical support across factory and warehouse operations, including laptops, workstations, handheld scanners, label printers, kiosks, time clocks, badge printers, and production-adjacent systems.

 - Deploy, configure, and maintain Zebra hardware across all locations, including wireless barcode scanners, charging docks, and thermal transfer label printers. Calibrate printers, troubleshoot print quality, perform preventive maintenance, and partner with manufacturing on label and ribbon selection.

 - Manage the IT ticket queue through Jira Service Management and support channels (chat, email, and in-person), prioritizing issues based on operational impact.

 - Own end-to-end employee onboarding and offboarding, including laptop and scanner provisioning, badges, SIM cards, account access, and device returns or wipes.

 - Troubleshoot basic network and connectivity issues across factory and warehouse environments, including Wi-Fi, switches, access points, and printer connectivity. Partner with Manufacturing Engineering to resolve IT issues impacting production across both shifts.

 - Maintain IT asset inventory, spare-parts stock, and software license and access audits. Develop technical documentation, self-service troubleshooting resources, and IT procedures while identifying opportunities to improve ticketing workflows.





WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 1+ years of IT support or help desk experience, ideally in a manufacturing, warehouse, or logistics environment.

 - Administration experience with common workplace tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Okta, Microsoft 365, Zoom) and ticketing systems (Jira)

 - Technical troubleshooting experience across Windows and Mac devices, with a working knowledge of networking fundamentals (Wi-Fi, switches, VLANs, DHCP, and static IPs).

 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to support employees at all levels and serve as a visible, approachable IT resource on the production floor.

 - Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to independently manage a ticket queue, prioritize competing requests, and handle in-person walk-ups.

 - Ability to create clear technical documentation and self-service guides.

 - A valid driver’s license

 - Hands-on experience with Zebra scanners and printers (deployment, calibration, print-quality tuning, basic maintenance); familiarity with ZPL, ZDNA and managed device fleets (MDM) is a plus




ABOUT THE TEAM

Base's IT team is building the infrastructure for a company that's growing fast, with new locations launching multiple times a year. You would be on the ground floor in setting the standards Base uses as we scale. It's a small team with broad ownership across security, networking, OT, and site IT, so the impact of getting it right (or wrong) is immediate and visible. If you want to join a quickly expanding team and get experience with every function of IT, this is the team for you.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

Are you tired of working hard at a dead-end J-O-B and no appreciation for your contributions?

Are you working as a lube tech or in another position in the maintenance shop, but your company does not provide education or tools?
Then this is the opportunity of a lifetime! Cox Fleet, a national leader in mobile onsite fleet maintenance, is proud to announce open enrollment into our next FleeTec Academy class. FleeTec Academy is a paid educational program that leads to a path to becoming one of our full-time Diesel Technicians. It was established by us to help people get into the Diesel Maintenance field who otherwise might not be able to afford to spend over a year of their life at an expensive formal Technical School with all of the associated tuition debt and buy all of the necessary tools for the job without maxing out their credit card.
That’s right, we pay you to go through our program, we give you free education on fundamentals of Diesel Engines and how to fix trucks, along with a set of hand tools with toolbox, to get you on your way to be the best Diesel Technician out there!
Sounds too good to be true. What is the catch, right? Here is what we ask from you in return: You must be willing to study hard (and we mean HARD!) for five (5) weeks of full-time schooling at our Academy Campus. Oh, and keep the tools.
To summarize:
10 weeks paid classroom training; all travel expenses paid.
Free Technical Education
Further hands-on training by one of our technicians and a full-time job with us as a Mobile Diesel Mechanic in your market.
Our Mobile Technicians are assigned a state-of-the-art vehicle, with all the bells and whistles, which they use to perform vehicle repairs at our customers’ locations. You are not going to be doing emergency truck repairs on a side of the road as part of your everyday duties, but rather go to our customers’ locations to do preventative maintenance and general repairs onsite, so they can keep their vehicles running efficiently without having to take them to the shop.
Real pay rates that you can afford to pay rent with and a predefined pathway for raises.
​

$16/h (or state minimum wages, whichever is greater) + $250 / one wk. stipend (taxed)
$19/h after that for 6 weeks
Then 2nd class for 4 weeks at Indy at $19/h + $250 / wk. (taxed)
Then $21/h upon graduation.
Sounds like something you might be interested in. Apply now! Our class size is kept extremely small to ensure we can dedicate the time teaching our future technicians properly. We only have one spot in each geographical market we hire, so it will be competitive. Could that next hire, be you?
Here is what you bring to the table:
Desire to start a career as a Diesel Technician and become one of our Mobile Mechanics.
Bring a willingness and ability to study hard.
Dedicate 10 weeks away from home to be with us.
Maturity level to focus on the task at hand. This is not a summer camp, but a start of your career path.
Technical aptitude and a passion for fixing vehicles.
Ability to operate iPad.
Must be 21 to drive one of our trucks.
High School Diploma or an equivalent combination of education is preferred but not required.
We conduct background checks, driving records checks, pre-employment drug testing and physical.

The Mobile Inspector functions as a key member of the Manheim Mobile Inspections team, responsible for conducting on‑site vehicle condition inspections for dealer clients within an assigned territory. This role provides accurate, detailed, and timely documentation of vehicle condition in accordance with Manheim inspection standards, supporting client trust, marketplace transparency, and inventory flow.
Mobile Inspectors build strong relationships with dealer clients by delivering consistent, high‑quality inspections, acting as brand ambassadors for Cox Automotive, and actively engaging dealers to grow participation in Manheim’s mobile inspection services.
This role requires the ability to work with minimal supervision while demonstrating increasing independence, sound judgment, and problem‑solving skills.

Locate, start, move, inspect, and return vehicles safely on dealer client lots.

Inspect and document vehicle exterior condition, including tires, frame, glass, panels, and mechanical components. Inspect and document interior condition, including seating, dashboard, and installed options.

Collaborate closely with Wholesale Specialists, peers, and other Manheim teams to support client success.
Work effectively within a continuous improvement and Lean environment, contributing to process enhancement.

Demonstrate a visible commitment to safety by following all safety and health procedures.

description:

DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last mile logistics in the long term. If you have a passion for applying robotics solutions in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!

We're hiring a State Estimation & Perception Engineer in our Autonomy Software team. In this role, you'll own and develop the perception and state estimation for our package pickup and delivery system. You'll influence system design decisions, including sensor selection, sensing architecture, and observability analysis, at the earliest stage when choices still matter.
You're excited about this opportunity because you will…
Play an integral role on a small and focused team
Own tuning and implementation of the state estimation stack on the drone (PX4 EKF modifications, fault tolerance, multi-sensor fusion with VIO and laser odometry)

You have strong C++ and/or Rust skills, with Python for prototyping and analysis
You have experience deploying estimation on real hardware with real sensor noise

You're driven by a passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences

Experience with PX4 / ArduPilot EKF internals
Experience with multi-body state estimation (tethered or suspended payloads)

About the Team
DoorDash for Business is building the premier corporate dining and benefits platform—helping companies of all sizes feed their teams through industry-leading products and meal programs. Our mission is to become the go-to solution for executives, administrators, and employees who need seamless, high-quality food programs at work. We move fast, operate with an ownership mindset, and are growing new product lines to better serve our corporate customers.
About the Role
As a Senior Associate on the DoorDash for Business Strategy & Operations team, you will help grow and run Self-Serve Meal Manager, our free, self-serve product that automates recurring meals for teams and offices. Because the product is self-serve, growth is product-led: customers find us, sign up, set up a calendar, and decide whether to stay without a sales rep in the loop. Your job is to make every stage of that funnel work better.
Acquire: Bring new teams in at the top of the funnel, both on the DoorDash platform (merchandising, in-app placements, lifecycle messaging) and off platform (paid, email, and organic channels).
Activate: Turn sign-ups into first orders through strong onboarding, and find and fix where customers drop off.
Retain: Keep teams ordering through a reliable, high-quality product experience, and catch the issues that cause churn before customers leave.
This is a role for someone versatile who will wear many hats: analyst, growth operator, customer-facing problem solver, and product partner. You will be expected to find a problem in the data, work out why it is happening, and drive the fix yourself. The role is built to grow. As the product scales, so will your scope and ownership.
You will report to the Manager, Strategy & Operations for DoorDash for Business and can work remotely or hybrid depending on preference.

Own the funnel: Analyze the self-serve funnel end to end, from visitor to sign-up to activation to repeat ordering. Find where customers drop off and run experiments on acquisition channels, onboarding, selection, and promotions to lift conversion and retention.
Go deep on the data: Write SQL daily to size problems, segment customers, measure lift, and tell a real result from noise. Build the dashboards and automated checks that let a small team support a growing customer base.

Improve reliability: Root cause order defects such as late deliveries, point of sale issues, and failed drop-offs. Work with merchants, Dashers, and support partners on fixes and track the impact on quality metrics.

Influence the roadmap: Bring customer, merchant, and order data to product, engineering, and operations partners as clear recommendations.

title: Executive Director, MISUMI Imprint Foundation
description:
About MISUMI Americas
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
About the Foundation
MISUMI Imprint Foundation is the first corporate giving organization in MISUMI Group 's history. It launched in October 2026 with a $2 million seed investment from MISUMI Americas and a mandate to fund the people who will build the physical world.
The reasoning is straightforward. MISUMI supplies the components that engineers design into machines, and as AI moves out of software and into factories, vehicles, operating rooms, and orbit, demand is rising for engineers, machinists, and technicians who can build hardware that works safely and reliably in the real world. The United States is not producing enough of them. The Foundation exists to widen that pipeline.
We make grants in three areas:

description:

Fortune Brands Innovations is hiring a Manager, Product Integrity to join our Connected Products team .  Product Integrity is the team that confirms our connected products — Flo by Moen water devices, Yale and August smart locks, and Master Lock connected padlocks — do what their requirements say they do before they reach a customer. This role leads that team and owns the bridge between requirements and proof: taking what Product, Systems Architecture, and Compliance ask for and turning it into tests with a method, a sample size, and a pass/fail criterion.
The role also owns 100% end-of-line testing at the factory, including test fixture design and test software. Depending on test complexity, fixtures are built fully in-house or developed with a supplier.
We are looking for a systems architect who leads a test team . The right person understands the whole product — electrical, mechanical, firmware, and how they interact — well enough to argue a requirement with Product, an interface with Architecture, and the statistics with Reliability, and then run the lab that proves it.
Position location: this position is eligible to work in a hybrid environment out of our North Olmsted, OH or San Francisco, CA locations.
What you will own
The Product Integrity team. Lead a team of test engineers covering production and 100% test, hardware test, reliability test, quality inspection, and overall confirmation of product requirements. You set the direction and the standard; the team executes.
Requirements into tests. Turn every hardware requirement in the PRD — from Product, Systems Architecture, and Compliance — into a testable requirement with a method, a sample size, an acceptance criterion, and a gate. Product defines the design envelope; you define how we test to it.
Gate evidence. Every stage gate (EVT, DVT, PVT) carries your evidence package: what was tested, against which requirement, with what result.
Reliability. Define the reliability test plan for each program and own the statistics behind it: sample sizes, confidence levels, and acceleration factors for environmental testing.
Production test. Develop fixtures and test software that meet approved cycle times, with test limits tied to expected field performance.
Field performance. Review returns and field data, and feed what you learn back into requirements and test plans.
The team and the logistics
Team: test engineers covering production test, hardware test, reliability test, and quality inspection. The lab is in North Olmsted.
Location: North Olmsted, OH or San Francisco, CA. If based in San Francisco, expect occasional travel to North Olmsted.
Travel: ~15%. Travel to factories in Nogales and Tecate, Mexico; Hanoi, Vietnam; and between North Olmsted and San Francisco.
Qualifications
10+ years on connected consumer hardware spanning electrical, mechanical, and firmware.
Experience developing factory test fixtures at both board level and end of line.
Experience writing requirements and V&V plans.
Reliability engineering fluency: accelerated life testing, Weibull and AFR math, sample sizing at a stated confidence, HALT/HASS, thermal, drop, and cycle life. You can design a plan and read a failure.
Production test experience: fixtures, test software, DFT, cycle time, and yield at a contract manufacturer.
Has led a small technical team and is comfortable setting direction for test engineers who are more hands-on than you.
Nice to have
Battery power model development.
Sensor products with calibration and drift requirements.
Sealed or outdoor enclosures.
RF performance characterization.
Certification literacy across safety (UL), RF (FCC), and interop (Matter/CSA); NSF/IAPMO for water products or BHMA for locks.

description:
Job Description:
ITW Shakeproof is a division of Illinois Tool Works (ITW) which supplies cold headed & metal stamped fasteners totaling approximately $200M in revenue annually. Manufacturing/Warehouse locations include Watertown, WI, Milwaukee, WI, Broadview, IL, Elgin, IL, Machesney Park, IL, and Iron Ridge, WI, with a Sales, and Innovation / Strategic Marketing team primarily in Troy, Michigan. We serve major OEMs and their tier suppliers direct and through distribution channels in the automotive and industrial markets.  ITW Shakeproof Fasteners drives profitability by leveraging its innovative solutions and application engineering, allowing us to enhance our customers’ competitive advantage. Known for innovation, diversification, and excellent financial performance.   We are never, whether we know it or not, more than a few steps from an innovative ITW solution.
This position is a divisional resource responsible for ensuring exemplary support of quality complaints at our automotive and industrial customers. The Quality Engineer is instrumental in ensuring product quality for customers and investigating and remediating potential issues. As a customer facing role, the individual should expect frequent travel to our customer locations (primarily in the Midwest).
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
The QA/QC Lab Inspector performs and assists in the physical and metallurgical tests on start-up and in-process production parts in a metal fastener facility. Perform tasks associated with the verification and validation of part quality.
Performs preparation techniques of Metallurgical mounts such as grinding, cutting, polishing, etching products.
Operate and interpret findings from Micro-Hardness testing equipment on prepared mounts.
Performs Start-up and in-process tests on production parts. Have the ability to stop production if parts do not pass.
Reads and understands print drawings and specifications for correct test requirements, procedures, and sampling plans.
Verify calibration on all equipment within the lab and from the factory floor prior to use.
Reports any safety violations, test equipment misuse and/or improper work to the Supervisor.
Verifies and ensures that all jobs and materials have accurate information on the Manufacturing Order Route Packet prior to release to the production floor.
Receive and document sample parts into the Quality Lab tracking system.
Review the lab test results to ensure all operations have been properly performed and recorded.
Conducts lab sampling as needed.
Issue and track production gages to the manufacturing floor.
Proper handling and use of low-level acids as part of the metal etching process.
Attend the Material Review Board meetings when required.
Sort parts in the lab if required.
Supports and maintains waste elimination initiatives at the facility.
Continually seeks opportunities to improve by taking advantage of available training.
Attend all Company and department meetings are required
Inspects fasteners for conformance to specifications by performing a variety of testing.
Compares product with parts list or sample model to ensure completion of assembly.
Completes final inspection reports for each lot of parts.
Examines material or product for surface defects such as cracks, or obvious plating defects.
Verifies specified dimensions of product or material.
Rejects defective parts and marks type of defect on part, container of parts, or inspection tag.
Verifies that all required operations are complete and correct; ensure that lot integrity is maintained.
Operates comparator as required to inspect parts for dimensional requirements.
Completes final inspection reports for each lot of parts.
Ensures compliance with all company safety rules and procedures.
Performs other duties as assigned.

High School Diploma or equivalent education.
Prefer minimum of 1-2 years of Metallurgical or physical laboratory experience.
Understanding of test equipment and procedures to include various hand gaging equipment and desk top test equipment.
Basic Microsoft Office understanding and usage.
Ability and wiliness to learn new techniques and procedures.
